d:
The Gada family is excited to go to London together, but Jethalal discovers that the dealer scheme only covers an individual ticket for him, not the family. Guilt-ridden, he reveals the truth to Champaklal, Daya, and Tapu, deciding he won’t go either if his family can't join.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
